channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: UN panel says Epstein abuses may constitute ‘crimes against humanity’
item.description: Experts say newly released documents show the need for an independent investigation into Epstein's sex-trafficking ring.

item.title: Police arrest man with shotgun running towards US Capitol building
item.description: The suspect, identified as Carter Camacho from the US state of Georgia, was wearing a tactical vest and gloves.

item.title: ‘Tug of war’: Democrats push Trump to release New York City tunnel funds
item.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul said the $77m released Tuesday falls short of the amount owed for the transport project.

item.title: Kremlin official says Russian navy to stop West’s seizure of merchant ships
item.description: Russian official says Western powers seizing sanctioned vessels carrying Moscow's oil commit 'piracy-like attacks'.

item.title: Over 80 film workers slam Berlin festival’s silence on Israel’s Gaza war
item.description: Tilda Swinton and Javier Bardem among actors and directors expressing dismay at Berlinale's 'anti-Palestinian racism'.

item.title: Iran says ‘good progress’ made in nuclear talks with US in Geneva
item.description: Top diplomat says Iran and US reached an understanding on 'guiding principles' in nuclear talks as tensions persist.

item.title: Over 80 UN member states condemn Israel’s de facto annexation of West Bank
item.description: UN warns that Israel's plan will lead to widespread dispossession of Palestinian land in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Washington appoints new US envoy on Tibetan human rights
item.description: China has previously criticised the role, accusing the US of interfering in China’s internal affairs.

item.title: LIVE: Israel steps up attacks, land takeover across occupied West Bank
item.description: Ramped-up raids, violent settler attacks and bulldozed homes - Israel escalates its assault on the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Philippine VP Sara Duterte announces run for president in 2028
item.description: Announcement follows multiple impeachment complaints against the vice president over allegations of corruption.
